note: Block hierarchy of the live process-flow panel (static/flow.js). status: built or planned. live.signal: live, after_the_fact, grouped or static. There is no production view (D18).

blocks.label: Human demo V
blocks.summary: One marker clip and a task sentence enter the pipeline.
blocks.details: Marker clips only: table, bowl and plate carry ArUco markers. Bowl-on-plate only.

live.note: pipeline_stage video

blocks.label: Demo extraction
blocks.summary: Differs from the paper: demos use hand tracking and fiducial markers from hurobo, not SAM 3.1. Only marker-setup clips work. SAM 3 is used in the rollouts instead.
blocks.details: Controlled setup: one static camera, known intrinsics, markers. A rejected clip stops the pipeline.

live.note: pipeline_stage extract; inner steps are not reported

blocks.label: Hand tracking
blocks.summary: Per-frame hand TCP (thumb and index midpoint) and pinch aperture.

live.note: Part of the extract stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Marker poses
blocks.summary: ArUco poses of table, bowl and plate; static camera averaged over the clip.
blocks.details: Objects are assumed static within a demo: start pose only.

live.note: Part of the extract stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Grasp and release
blocks.summary: Grasp and release frames from the aperture, with hysteresis thresholds.

live.note: Part of the extract stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Abstraction z
blocks.summary: Object-relative JSON: keyframes, end-effector path, aperture, summary for the prompt.
blocks.details: Distances in metres and as a fraction of the object radius, so they carry over to a simulator object of a different size.

live.note: pipeline_stage demospec

blocks.label: Prompt
blocks.summary: The context the generator reads: task, demo abstraction, API signatures, scene text and, for repairs, E3 contact evidence.
blocks.details: Improvement happens only through this context; nothing is trained.

live.note: pipeline_stage prompt

blocks.label: Reply cache
blocks.summary: Generation and its repairs: every model call is cached on disk by model, messages and temperature, so a resumed run spends nothing on repeated calls.
blocks.details: A cache hit is marked on the attempt card. Rewrites in the Adversary loop go through Muse Code and are not in this disk cache.

live.note: not reported live; attempts show from_cache

blocks.label: Program generator
blocks.summary: Writes a plain cap_harness script over ASPIRE primitives, not the paper's four-primitive run(robot). Direct API call with --explain, repaired on the nominal seed.
blocks.details: Develop-and-repair runs up to the retry limit, under a hard token cap.

live.note: pipeline_stage generate; inner steps are not reported

blocks.label: Model call
blocks.summary: Muse Wonder returns the program text; replies are cached and tokens logged.

live.note: Part of the generate stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Static checks
blocks.summary: Pre-flight AST check: syntax, call whitelist, no imports except math.

live.note: Part of the generate stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Debug rollout
blocks.summary: The program runs on the debug seed; a failure feeds the next repair attempt.

live.note: Part of the generate stage: only the stage as a whole reports.

blocks.label: Nominal replay
blocks.summary: The policy must pass its nominal cases before it may be attacked.
blocks.details: Otherwise the run ends as no_working_policy and escalates.

live.note: Started by the loop's start row, which is logged just before the nominal rollouts. No event marks its end: the first attack result proves it passed.

blocks.label: Rollout
blocks.summary: Sandboxed program in cap_harness on LIBERO-Pro. Perception by SAM 3 (sam-3.1 is optional), IK by PyRoki, interpolated trajectories. cuRobo is not used in /policy-dev; see execution.json.
blocks.details: Adversary.attack() runs selector, proposer, rollout and diagnoser in one synchronous call.

live.note: attack_event fires when the call returns. A dashed pulse means inferred: the previous cycle ended and the loop goes on, so the next attack is running, but no event marks its start.

blocks.label: Category selector
blocks.summary: Beta posterior per category, or uniform at η = 1. Categories wired: pose, physics, size, actuation, camera, lighting.

live.note: Inside Adversary.attack(): one synchronous call, no per-step events. All inner steps show the same grouped state; their order and timing are not observed live.

blocks.label: Proposer + clamp
blocks.summary: muse-spark-1.3 through the Meta Model API. Whether the API exposes the Instant, Thinking and Contemplating modes by name is not confirmed; effort levels map to them in models/base.py. M = 4 independent calls. Severity is clamped in code whatever the model returned.

live.note: Inside Adversary.attack(): one synchronous call, no per-step events. All inner steps show the same grouped state; their order and timing are not observed live.

blocks.label: Sandboxed rollout
blocks.summary: Runs the program under the perturbation; a crash is ERROR, never a task failure.
blocks.details: About 40 s per run on the real simulator.

live.note: Inside Adversary.attack(): one synchronous call, no per-step events. All inner steps show the same grouped state; their order and timing are not observed live.

blocks.label: Mock world
blocks.summary: Offline toy world with one failure mechanism per category.

live.note: Which backend ran is in the run_started event, not per step.

blocks.label: cap_harness backend
blocks.summary: Real LIBERO rollout in ASPIRE, run as a subprocess; writes trace and video.

live.note: Which backend ran is in the run_started event, not per step.

blocks.label: localize_object
blocks.summary: Harness perception from SAM 3 and RGB-D.

live.note: Called by the program inside the rollout; not reported live.

blocks.label: generate_grasps
blocks.summary: Harness grasp generation (Contact-GraspNet).

live.note: Called by the program inside the rollout; not reported live.

blocks.label: move_to_pose
blocks.summary: Harness motion planning (PyRoki, cuRobo).

live.note: Called by the program inside the rollout; not reported live.

blocks.label: Failure history H
blocks.summary: Append-only attack log and per-category counts; F_n for the gate.

live.note: Inside Adversary.attack(): one synchronous call, no per-step events. All inner steps show the same grouped state; their order and timing are not observed live.

blocks.label: Explainer
blocks.summary: muse-spark-1.3 through the Meta Model API. Whether the API exposes the Instant, Thinking and Contemplating modes by name is not confirmed; effort levels map to them in models/base.py.

live.note: Inside Adversary.attack(): one synchronous call, no per-step events. All inner steps show the same grouped state; their order and timing are not observed live.

blocks.label: Diagnoser
blocks.summary: muse-spark-1.3 through the Meta Model API. Whether the API exposes the Instant, Thinking and Contemplating modes by name is not confirmed; effort levels map to them in models/base.py. Compares against the nominal run. Rules are the fallback, and the only diagnoser when the model is mock.
blocks.details: Runs inside attack(), so it finishes with it. Skipped when the attack did not fail the policy.

live.note: Proven by attack_event with a failure outcome: the report carries the diagnosis. No live running state exists.

blocks.label: Rewrite π′
blocks.summary: Run by muse exec with docs/orchestrator/phases.md at the top of the prompt. The class is named MuseOrchestrator, but the model only writes the candidate: the loop, gate and stop rules stay in code.
blocks.details: About 46k tokens per rewrite in the logged test runs.

live.note: Running from attack_event with a failure, which fires just before the rewrite call, until the cycle row.

blocks.label: Regression gate
blocks.summary: No worse on every case seen and better on at least one. One pure function; no model decides.
blocks.details: A crash on a case the incumbent passed is a regression. The candidate replays every case seen so far.

live.note: The replay runs inside Loop with no event, so the block only shows the verdict from the cycle row. Its replay time counts toward Muse rewrites.

blocks.label: Save to deploy
blocks.summary: /deploy copies the highest accepted version to data/deploy/.

live.note: pipeline_stage deploy only.

blocks.label: Experience memory M
blocks.summary: Not built (decision D18). In the paper; concept only for the hackathon.
blocks.details: Concept slide only, no code. Never lights up.

live.note: Planned: no runtime exists.

blocks.label: Ask a human
blocks.summary: After W stalled cycles. Implemented as a typed answer that becomes a constraint; the paper's targeted demonstration V′ is not built.

live.note: loop_event escalate and human_answer, and awaiting_answer. It waits on the person, so this is truly live.
